caveats: Official construction-land parcel layer; not all land types or a title/ownership service.
Fixed z12 source-tile outlines may be generalized relative to cadastral master geometry. Source polygons remain unchanged after exact geographic conversion; no clipping, fitting, rounding or repair.
Tile/geometry-derived references change with edits, retiling, ring order or zoom; mvt_id is not a durable cadastral ID. Unknown references return unresolved rather than authoritative absence.
EPSG:4326 service declaration versus EPSG:4490 viewer datum remains unverified; no fitted offset applied.
Old Street belongs to Shihezi since 2017 according to public regional reporting; legacy Shawan labels and cadastral jurisdiction/version remain follow-ups.
Native tile transport cannot filter attributes; adapter discards all provider attributes immediately after decoding.
